verses.1: Remember, my brothers, and do not forget what was told you before: that God preserves the righteousness of those who do good.
verses.2: And their fruit shall multiply upon the earth, and their memory shall endure forever for good; and their seed, a plant, shall not be cut off from upon the earth.
verses.3: And He will deliver them from the hand of all their oppressors and their enemies who hate them, because for their sake He will fight for them, and He will not abandon them into the hand of their adversary.
verses.4: And He will be a helper to them out of their affliction, for those who love His name; and He will have mercy on them and forgive them all their sins.
